metadata.chemistry_rationale: Four-envelope PDI-Me-COOH hypothesis. The two aryl-methyl carbons are treated as unresolved within aromatic_C-C_C=C because they share a hydrocarbon-like environment and the raw C 1s line shape does not show an isolated methyl feature.
metadata.position_basis: Absolute uncalibrated guesses transferred from the homologous PDI-H-COOH model; the PDI-Me-COOH raw maximum is 284.500054 eV and sample-wide calibration is applied only after review.
